title: 2026 UK ETS installation monitoring-plan change QA controls

sources.title: UK ETS for installations: how to comply
UK ETS for installations: how to comply - publication

facts.fact: Operators must regularly check that the monitoring plan reflects the nature and functioning of the installation.
The review includes whether monitoring methodology and control systems can be improved.
Operators must monitor effectiveness of control measures including risk assessment.
Verifier recommendations may require monitoring-plan changes.
Changes to the monitoring plan must be notified to the regulator.
A plan must change if emissions arise from activities not identified in the plan.
A plan must change when new instruments, sampling or analysis can determine emissions more accurately.
A plan must change when previously applied methodology is found to produce incorrect data.
A plan must change when a change would make reported data more accurate unless technically infeasible or unreasonably costly.
A plan must change when it does not meet MRR requirements and the regulator requires a change.

guard_patterns.rule: Separate periodic review from a required plan change.
Preserve verifier recommendation versus regulator requirement.
Do not claim improved accuracy without the cited change condition.
